topics.title: Lake Mead hits a record low
topics.summary: Lake Mead has fallen to its lowest level since the reservoir was created, keeping attention on water use across the Colorado River system.
topics.discussionPrompt: If the apartment had to save water for a week, who would become the shower timer, and who would try to negotiate loopholes?

topics.title: Perseid meteor shower reaches peak
topics.summary: The Perseid meteor shower peaks this week, with dark moon conditions expected to make the late-night sky show especially good for many viewers.
topics.discussionPrompt: If everyone went outside to watch meteors, who would bring snacks, who would bring a telescope, and who would fall asleep first?

topics.title: European athletics opens in Birmingham
topics.summary: The 2026 European Athletics Championships opened in Birmingham, bringing a week of track and field events to Alexander Stadium.
topics.discussionPrompt: Which event would this group be weirdly overconfident about trying: relay, high jump, shot put, or just dramatic cheering?

topics.title: Western wildfires prompt evacuations
topics.summary: Wildfires across western Canada and the western U.S. are forcing evacuations and emergency support as hot, dry conditions keep fire crews busy.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a neighborhood has to prepare fast, who stays practical with a checklist, and who packs the strangest comfort item?
